privacy_intro_body: At Maghsalati we're committed to protecting your personal data. This policy explains what we collect, how we use it, and how we keep it safe.
privacy_data_body: We collect your name, phone number, email address and pickup location, along with your order details. This data is needed to process and deliver your order.
privacy_usage_body: We use your data to process orders, determine pickup and delivery locations, send order status notifications, and improve the quality of our service.
privacy_sharing_body: We never sell your data. We only share the information needed with the laundry and the delivery courier to complete your order, such as your address and phone number.
privacy_security_body: We use an encrypted connection to protect your data in transit, and apply security measures to limit unauthorized access to your account.
privacy_rights_body: You can update your details at any time from the Edit Profile screen, and you may request deletion of your account and data by contacting us.
contact_header_body: If you have any question or an issue with your order, reach out through whichever channel suits you and we'll get back to you shortly.

about_tagline: Professional laundry and ironing, delivered to your door
about_who_body: Maghsalati connects you with the best laundries near you. Pick a laundry and a service, and we'll handle pickup, washing and delivery at a time that suits you.
about_feature_fast_body: We collect your order and return it as quickly as possible, with the option to choose your pickup and delivery times.
about_feature_quality_body: We work with carefully selected laundries that use fabric-safe products and take care of your clothes.
about_feature_tracking_body: Follow your order step by step, from the moment it's collected until it's back in your hands.

driver_privacy_intro_body: We care about protecting your data as a delivery driver. This policy explains what data we collect from you and how we use and protect it.
driver_privacy_data_body: We collect your name, phone number and profile photo, your vehicle details and plate number, required documents such as your license and ID, as well as your trip history and earnings.
driver_privacy_location_body: We only use your location while you're available, to match you with nearby orders and track the trip from pickup to drop-off. Once you turn availability off, we stop tracking your location.
driver_privacy_usage_body: We use your data to verify your account, send you suitable orders, calculate your earnings, send order notifications, and improve our service.
driver_privacy_sharing_body: We never sell your data. We only share your name, vehicle details and location during a trip with the customer and the laundry so the order goes smoothly.
driver_privacy_rights_body: You can review and update your data at any time, and you can ask us to deactivate your account or delete your data by contacting us.
driver_contact_header_body: If you have any question or an issue with a trip or your account, reach out through whichever channel suits you and we'll get back to you shortly.
